**A tidier interface, and a survival check that sees the caves' lava**

The Survival check counts the lava (and water) of Caves layers, so a map with lava caves no longer says "No lava for a Nether portal"; its Relief chart shows the heights of dry land only, the share under water said under it instead of one spike at the sea; while it reads, its loader sits level with the title, and its button says Close. Compact mode is the first setting of Settings ▸ Appearance, with a line saying what it does, and View ▸ Compact mode turns it on and off. Every Settings page now has the same height, so the window no longer jumps or cuts a page short; Memory's values line up in a column; World Information shows the map, memory and file in aligned rows; the export dialog's Game and World border boxes are level, with their options at the start; the settings of the generator's nodes and of Edit ▸ Whole map have their names aligned left; buttons on one line share one height (Game & mods, the seed's dice); About closes from the bottom right like every dialog; and buttons read in sentence case (Start recording, Test export…, Copy summary).
